arguments.command:
cd /workspace && cat > tmp/dbgplan.py << 'EOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace')
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import importlib.util
spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location('m','/workspace/submission/main.py')
m = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec); spec.loader.exec_module(m)
req = json.load(open('/workspace/tmp/bad_case.json'))
caps = m.parse_capacities(req['capacities'])
flows = m.parse_flows(req['flows'], caps, False)
warmup = req['warmup']; pinned = m.parse_pinned(req['pinned'], flows)
offers = m.parse_offers(req['offers'], flows)
print('caps',caps)
ben={}
for fid, flow in flows.items():
    nodes=flow['N']; hops=nodes-1
    per=(flow['H']-4-flow['nd'])*nodes
    total=0; index=0
    for header,count in offers[fid]:
        end=index+count
        if end>warmup:
            start=max(index,warmup)
            e=end-start
            if (int.from_bytes(header,'big')&flow['kmask'])!=flow['kval'] or header[flow['q_off']]>7 or header[flow['t_off']]<=hops:
                e=0
            total+=per*e
        index=end
    ben[fid]=total
    print(fid, flow['path'], 'ben',total, 'per',per,'nd',flow['nd'],'H',flow['H'])
print('warmup',warmup,'pinned',pinned)
res = m.run_plan(caps, flows, warmup, pinned, offers)
print('got', res)
EOF
python3 tmp/dbgplan.py
